summary_en: ¥2.5B maximum, 1,000,000 shares (1.8% S/O), open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, Oct 13, 2026–Mar 31, 2027. Rationale: offset equity dilution from concurrent share offering and strengthen shareholder returns; final terms delegated to CEO.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Central Automotive Products resolved on 28 August 2026 to acquire up to 1,000,000 of its ordinary shares, representing 1.8% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥2.5 billion. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 13 October 2026 and 31 March 2027. The stated rationale is to mitigate equity dilution from a concurrent public share offering, enhance shareholder returns, and improve capital efficiency. The board delegated final execution terms to the CEO. Completion is subject to market conditions and is not guaranteed.
